HOW IT WORKS

blocks.alt: The check screen before joining: camera preview, microphone level, and four green checks.

blocks.text: 1CHECK
Open the studio. Your camera, microphone, browser and free space are checked before you start.

blocks.alt: The host's studio with a guest named Matt waiting, and Let in and Deny buttons.

blocks.text: 2LET IN
Send your guest one link. They wait until you click Let in, so only people you invite get in.

blocks.alt: The studio mid-recording: host and guest on camera, a red REC timer and the station log.

blocks.text: 3RECORD
Press Start recording. Both computers record in full quality while the log shows what is saved.

blocks.alt: The files page: a video file and an audio file for each person, all marked Complete.

blocks.text: 4DOWNLOAD
Stop, and the files are ready: a video and an audio file per person, plus a timeline for your editor.
BUILT SO A RECORDING DOES NOT GO MISSING

items.text:
19:03:10
You press Start recording. Both computers record in full quality.

19:41:52
Your guest's Wi-Fi drops for a minute. The call freezes. The recording does not.

19:42:57
Their connection is back. The pieces saved on their computer upload by themselves.

19:58:20
You press Stop. Every piece of every file is counted.

blocks.text: SAVED BEFORE IT IS SENT
Every few seconds the recording is written to the person's own computer first, then uploaded. Nothing waits on the call.
A CLOSED TAB IS NOT THE END
If a guest closes the tab or their laptop crashes, they open the same link again and the rest uploads.
MUTING ONLY AFFECTS THE CALL
Hide your camera or mute for a cough. Your recording keeps running, so your editor decides what to cut.
EVERY PIECE IS COUNTED
Your files page shows whether every part of every file arrived. You never find out at the edit.
EASY FOR YOUR GUESTS

Guests click your link, check their camera and microphone, and wait for you to let them in. Nothing to install, no account to make. When you finish, their recording finishes uploading and they can close the tab.

blocks.alt: A guest's phone: waiting for the host to let them in.
A guest's phone after recording: everything is uploaded.
